name: BoyfriendTV Scraper
description: Scrapes video and performer metadata and search candidates from boyfriend.tv and boyfriendtv.com.
author: Kari

settings.name: cookie
settings.description: Optional Cookie header from a signed-in, age-verified boyfriend.tv browser session. Needed because BoyfriendTV login is behind a Cloudflare challenge; you can instead paste it into the Password field of the BoyfriendTV login on the Downloads page.

settings.name: userAgent
settings.description: Optional browser User-Agent matching the session that generated your Cookie Header (Cloudflare cf_clearance cookies are bound to the originating User-Agent).
